g.text: The whole cluster runs in one thread, on virtual time
one thread · virtual time in Nanos · ChaCha8 seeded per component
byte for byte, macOS or Linux
links: latency dist, loss, dup, reorder, partition
warm, promoted on failover; never votes
engine = Rust replay, or Vx client through the C ABI
disks: in-memory journal with a fault model
invariants after every event · oracle diff per message · liveness after heal
